description: A structured profile of the candidate, every item resting on words copied from the résumé.

positions.description: Roles the candidate held, in résumé order.

organization.description: The employer as written; null when the résumé names none.

start.description: First month as YYYY-MM, or YYYY when only the year is given.

end.description: Last month as YYYY-MM or YYYY; "present" for a current role; null when unknown.

evidence.description: The résumé line with the title (and dates when they are on it), copied exactly, at most 300 characters.

statedYears.description: Years of professional experience the résumé states in so many words ("8 years of experience"); null when it states none. Never computed.

statedYearsEvidence.description: The words that state those years, copied exactly; null when statedYears is null.

technologies.description: Languages, frameworks, databases, platforms and tools the résumé names.

name.description: A short name, at most 60 characters.

evidence.description: The résumé words that show it, copied exactly, at most 300 characters.

skills.description: Abilities other than technologies that the résumé itself shows, each with its words; empty rather than guessed.

name.description: A short name, at most 60 characters.

evidence.description: The résumé words that show it, copied exactly, at most 300 characters.

domains.description: Business domains of the candidate's work as the résumé names them, each with its words; empty when it names none.

name.description: A short name, at most 60 characters.

evidence.description: The résumé words that show it, copied exactly, at most 300 characters.

experiences.description: Concrete projects, responsibilities and achievements, in résumé order, each one statement of the résumé.

text.description: The statement copied exactly from the résumé (one bullet or sentence), at most 300 characters.

context.description: The role and employer, or the project name, it belongs to, as written; null when unclear.
